title: Track and verify external reuse/usage outcomes
context: Hee-Lee Oss measures success as verifiable external adoption, not explainers produced. Reuse events must be externally verifiable — a partner-hosted URL, a teacher's written confirmation, a newsroom embed, or a citation. Self-reported use does not count. This task tracks and records reuse events to meet the M3 target of at least 3 verifiable events, and provides the Steward with a committed summary.
objective: Track and verify at least 3 external reuse or usage events for delivered explainers, each with externally verifiable evidence, and record them in the outcomes ledger.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 3 verifiable external reuse/usage events recorded: partner-hosted traffic, teacher reuse, newsroom embed, or citation — each with external evidence (no self-reported use).
Each event recorded in an outcomes/<explainer-id>.json artifact with: channel, URL or permalink, timestamp, data vintage, and applicable review sign-offs.
Evidence is externally verifiable (partner-hosted URL, written confirmation, merged embed, or published citation).
A reuse-tracking summary document is committed and accessible to the Steward and Maintainer.
resources: PLAN.md — Success metrics (verifiable external reuse/usage events)
PLAN.md — Quality, review & risk gates (Definition of Shipped)
partner-013 (prerequisite — at least one confirmed partner must exist)
output: A committed reuse-tracking summary document and at least 3 updated outcomes/<explainer-id>.json artifacts, each with externally verifiable evidence of reuse.
